tool_clock.method: Recovered original Harbor step/API intervals; one common scale, preserving relative gaps and tails.

scope: Compact six-call source windows with complete original prompt histories, not full task executions. No prompt padding/truncation or prescribed target output length.

schedule.arrival_model: Conditional Poisson process: independent sorted uniform times given fixed counts; 24 base arrivals over 360s; nested 2/6/24 extra arrivals over 90s.

limits: Fixed-count conditional Poisson arrivals; rates describe the conditional-count design, not a measured overload rate.
These are continuous source windows; shortening session lifetimes does not establish persistent Basin metastability.
Short cancellation requires server abort acknowledgement; model retains already-started P work/transfers until safe completion.
Same base/priming input and clock are shared across all groups. Reuse the steady control once per bandwidth.
